tagline: Stories That Matter, Connections That Last
description: An inspiring conversation series featuring healthcare experts, pedagogical innovators, campus leaders, and distinguished alumni discussing holistic child growth, modern education, and life skills.

episodes.title: Kautilya Konnect: Stories That Matter, Connections That Last
episodes.description: Welcome to the launch of Kautilya Konnect! Discover the philosophy behind 20+ years of value-grounded CBSE education in Mysore and our vision for balanced student learning.

episodes.title: How to Build Strong Bones & Prevent Disorders: Pediatric Health
episodes.description: Essential posture guidelines, calcium nutrition, physical active play, and preventative tips every parent needs to know for healthy bone development in growing children.

episodes.title: Doctor's Day: Honoring Healers & Inspiring Young Minds
episodes.description: Honoring healthcare champions and discussing the dedication, science, and empathy required in medical sciences to inspire young aspirants pursuing Science streams.

episodes.title: Campus Leadership, Lab Innovations & Progressive Pedagogy
episodes.description: A deep dive into Kautilya's experiential pedagogy, Atal Tinkering Lab hands-on robotics, and how student-centered classrooms nurture critical thinkers.

episodes.title: Enriching Conversations with Industry Pioneers & Environmental Leaders
episodes.description: Thought-provoking discussions on sustainable agriculture, career pathways, and instilling responsibility towards nature and society among young citizens.
